function: Uplink channel estimation by spatial-frequency extrapolation (KDD-SFCEN) and slot-level downlink channel extrapolation (TUDCEN) to cut pilot overhead under high mobility (p. 1).
system: TDD mmWave massive MIMO-OFDM, hybrid-precoding BS with 32 antennas, single UE with 4 antennas, 28 GHz, 624 subcarriers, no RIS (pp. 12-13).
method: Supervised attention-based network refining an LS estimate (KDD-SFCEN), 2D-CNN calibration network, and generative Transformer for autoregressive extrapolation; MSE/NMSE losses, Adam (pp. 7-12).
data_channel: MATLAB 5G Toolbox, CDL-B channel of TR 38.901 at 28 GHz; 95 channel instances for training and validation, 5 for testing; 9,000 training, 500 validation, 500 test samples (pp. 12-13).
test_conditions: Trained at 5 dB SNR and 60 km/h; tested at SNR -5 to 20 dB and speeds 5 to 120 km/h, on held-out channel instances (pp. 12-14).
baselines: Non-learned: linear spline and DFT interpolation; learned: SRCNN, FCNN, DRCN, SF-CNN for estimation, TPreNet and LSTM for slot-level extrapolation (pp. 13-15).
metrics: NMSE (dB) of uplink estimation, calibration and downlink extrapolation; achievable rate (bps/Hz); pilot overhead reduction factor (pp. 12-15).
complexity: Time and space complexity orders of the spatial-frequency sampling embedding layer, compared with 2D convolution and fully connected layers (p. 11); no runtime or FLOPs.
openness: none; data generated with the MATLAB 5G Toolbox, no code or data link (p. 12).
q1_support: p. 12: "We adopt the clustered delay line (CDL)-B MIMO channel model to generate channel instances [29]"; reference [29] is 3GPP TR 38.901, p. 16: "TR 38.901 V17.0.0".
q2_support: p. 14: "achieve the best performance when the testing UE velocity is equal to the training UE velocity"; trained at 60 km/h and tested at 5 to 120 km/h (Table I, p. 13) without retraining. The SNR sweep and held-out channel instances are not counted.
q3_support: p. 13: "including the linear spline interpolation method [9], the DFT-interpolation method [9], and the FCNN-based method [13]"; SRCNN, DRCN and SF-CNN are also compared on NMSE, and TPreNet and LSTM for slot-level extrapolation (p. 15).
q4_support: p. 11: "The time complexity of the spatial-frequency sampling embedding layer can be calculated as"; orders for time and space complexity (Eqs. 47-48) against 2D convolution and fully connected layers. No FLOPs or runtime for the whole framework.
q5_support: p. 12: "The simulation dataset is constructed using the MATLAB 5G toolbox [28]"; the data are generated by the authors with a toolbox and no code or data link appears.
notes: PDF is the arXiv preprint (arXiv:2406.08887v2, 29 Dec 2024), titled Low-Overhead Channel Estimation via 3D Extrapolation for TDD mmWave Massive MIMO Systems Under High-Mobility Scenarios. Area 2: uplink estimation and downlink channel prediction. Judgement call q2: the UE-speed test (Fig. 8) is counted as a new condition, a mobility not seen in training, unlike the SNR sweep. Judgement call q4: complexity orders are given only for the spatial-frequency sampling embedding layer, not for the full framework. q1 rests on CDL-B from TR 38.901 generated with the MATLAB 5G Toolbox.
